query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'caseId',a.case_id,'reviewSnapshotId',a.review_snapshot_id,'reviewerId',a.reviewer_id,'status',a.status::text,'dueAt',a.due_at,'version',a.version,'caseTitle',c.title) ORDER BY a.due_at NULLS LAST,a.created_at),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.review_assignments a JOIN editorial.cases c ON c.id=a.case_id WHERE a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS')
